text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, Trainer. There's something I'd 
like to ask your advice on...

As I was walking down the hallway, Agnes 
Digital called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't there a good way to swap out 
Tachyon-san's socks!?
choice_data_list: ...For now, tell me more in detail.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. When I passed Tachyon-san in the 
hallway earlier, her over-the-knee socks 
were sagging a little.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the elastic at the top has 
stretched out. I must have overlooked it 
when folding the laundry and put it away 
as is..."
choice_data_list: Are you the one folding her laundry?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't have any ulterior motives, 
okay!? Tachyon-san never puts her laundry 
away, so if I leave it, it gets mixed up 
with her discarded clothes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's because of my sloppy work... 
It must be such a pain for Tachyon-san to 
constantly have to pull up her thigh-highs 
every time they slip down...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to hand her a spare 
pair! For Tachyon-san's honor, preferably 
without making it obvious that I'm giving 
her socks!
Brava!! What a wonderful friendship!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Digital-kun, anguishing for the honor 
of a friend... I am deeply moved by your 
spirit."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't I bestow upon you the means to 
protect the spark of your friendship!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? Please do!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then choose! Will you seize victory 
through fierce battle, or trade for it 
through elegant intellect?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Digitan welcomes both with open arms!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then, Digital-kun's Trainer-san. Why 
don't you choose?"
choice_data_list:
In a fierce battle that will test your 
strength!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let us adorn their friendship 
with a fiery battle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What did you call me out here for?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh... This is what I came for!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san is holding out a sock...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon-san! I challenge you to a 
duel!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaaaaaah~?!?! A dueling glove?! An 
ultra-moe situation has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A duel between Opera O-san and 
Tachyon-san!! FHOOO! Every otaku's 
delusion made realityyy!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One is an artist, the other a 
scientist—total opposites! But pairing up 
polar opposites is precisely what being an 
otaku is all about!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If this duel were an analogy, it'd 
be the Knight Commander vs. the Grand 
Mage!! Nhaaa~~! There's literally nothing 
but pure moe here~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's in place of a dueling glove! I don't 
intend to break ties with you, so I won't 
throw it at your face.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Inside are socks. The wrapping was your 
friend's thoughtful gesture to keep it 
inconspicuous.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A duel just to deliver socks! Ahahaha! 
Your way of thinking—or rather, your 
mechanism for boosting abilities through 
autosuggestion—is absolutely fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, verification would take a 
substantial amount of time. I currently 
have other experiments I'd like to 
prioritize.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As for the socks... I've already spent 
half the day like this. It won't hurt to 
spend the rest of the day this way too. 
With that said, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Even as an opponent, 
bravo!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Such casual consideration to tell Digital 
not to worry about the socks! My heart is 
deeply moved by their friendship!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? You're looking down, Digital."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A duel... *grrr*! I wanted to see it so 
bad!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I see, you're disappointed that 
you didn't get to witness my heroic 
figure!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then when the opera 'Haohengrin' is 
performed, I will be sure to invite you!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyooo! I am deeply honored!! I'll make 
sure to bring a bath towel to wipe away my 
tears and join in!

It seemed Agnes Digital's worries were 
completely blown away by the moe 
situation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let us adorn their friendship 
with elegance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, fair Umamusume passing by, 
might we have a moment? We happen to be 
searching for someone.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking for the owner of this. —Now 
then, Digital-kun."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We are searching for the young 
Umamusume whose foot fits this sock 
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Could you perhaps try them on to see if 
they suit your legs, Tachyon-san...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, I don't mind if you try it out. Go 
ahead and put them on her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're the ones who wish to test 
it, aren't you? Only by carrying it out 
with your own hands can you obtain truly 
accurate experimental results!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we mustn't trouble her. Go right 
ahead, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Like this? Ah, should I get a little 
closer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ......Th-Th-This...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The official canon blew right past my 
wildest fantasies!! This is a complete moe 
capacity overload!

With a complicated expression that was 
half-crying, half-laughing, Agnes Digital 
screamed and fled the scene.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, so this is the closest proximity 
limit, is it? I'll need to check the 
detailed psychological state later as 
well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, it seems Digital-kun was the 
one being put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'll take these then. Now that you 
mention it, my socks might be a bit loose.

The spare socks were handed over to Agnes 
Tachyon. Now then, let's track down Agnes 
Digital and let her know mission 
accomplished—
